regions.merged_text: However, there is such a thing as "red communism" stealing into convents and monasterys. Very clever young men have been knowen to offer themselves as candidates for the Order who have turned out after months - sometime after years - to have been nothing more than secret promoters of unrest and red communism. Such candidates, I have heard of and in one case at least have known to show themselves very clever and experienced and naturally older than real promising candidates - say intheir late 20s or even middle 30s, and of course not too fervent atal, even tho at the same keeping the rule fairly to the letter. Of course, to suspect anyone definitely without a conscience observance and prayer, is a rather dangerous course. Nevertheless selfpreserva- tion and "charity beginning at home", where rightly ordered Charity always must begin; superiors especially are expected to be on the elert concerning any subject who persists in refusing tospeak to, or associate with any other member of the religious family.
